module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    input  ground,
    input  dig,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right,
    output reg aaah,
    output reg digging
);
    // State encoding: 00=walk left, 01=walk right, 10=fall, 11=dig
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; digging = 0; end
            2'b01: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 1; aaah = 0; digging = 0; end
            2'b10: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 0; aaah = 1; digging = 0; end
            2'b11: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; digging = 1; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: next_state = bump_left ? 2'b01 : (bump_right ? 2'b10 : (ground ? 2'b00 : (dig ? 2'b11 : 2'b00)));
            2'b01: next_state = bump_left ? 2'b10 : (bump_right ? 2'b00 : (ground ? 2'b01 : (dig ? 2'b11 : 2'b01)));
            2'b10: next_state = ground ? (bump_left ? 2'b01 : 2'b00) : (bump_left ? 2'b10 : (bump_right ? 2'b00 : 2'b10));
            2'b11: next_state = ground ? (bump_left ? 2'b01 : (bump_right ? 2'b00 : 2'b11)) : (bump_left ? 2'b10 : (bump_right ? 2'b00 : 2'b11));
        endcase
    end
endmodule

samples.raw_completion:
// Moore state machine, one-hot encoded state + combinational output
// (product of the state and an inline function of the state). Same
// result, shorter file.
module TopModule(input  clk, input  areset, input  bump_left, input  bump_right, input  ground, input  dig, output reg walk_left, output reg walk_right, output reg aaah, output reg digging);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b01;
        else        state <= next_state;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        next_state = state;
        aaah = 0; walk_left = 0; walk_right = 0; digging = 0;
        case (state)
            2'b01: begin walk_left = 1; if (bump_left) next_state = 2'b10; end
            2'b10: begin walk_right = 1; if (bump_right) next_state = 2'b01; end
            2'b11: begin aaah = 1; if (ground) next_state = 2'b01; else next_state = 2'b11; end
            default: begin walk_left = 1; end
        endcase
        if (ground) begin
            case (state)
                2'b01: begin walk_left = 1; if (bump_left) next_state = 2'b10; end
                2'b10: begin walk_right = 1; if (bump_right) next_state = 2'b01; end
                2'b11: begin aaah = 1; end
                default: begin walk_left = 1; end
            endcase
        end
        if (ground & dig) begin
            digging = 1;
            case (state)
                2'b01: begin walk_left = 1; next_state = 2'b01; end
                2'b10: begin walk_right = 1; next_state = 2'b10; end
                default: begin walk_left = 1; next_state = 2'b01; end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
